title: Data and code for: Human-AI rating asymmetries across evaluative dimensions in instruction-tuned open-weight language models (PLOS ONE revision)
description: Prompt grids, all raw responses of the audited open-weight language models (including the two excluded models and the attempted-but-unavailable model identifiers), per-response and per-cell measurements, result tables, figures, and the complete Python and R code that regenerates every number, table and figure of the manuscript and its S1 File. Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT License. Version 2.0.0 corresponds to the first revision of manuscript PONE-D-26-32490; see CHANGELOG.md for all changes relative to version 1.0.0.
